fields.statement: At e61a2366e re-ran the Checks block: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(apply-concurrent|apply|check)$' exit 0; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestApply exit 0; rhiza ship generate exit 0; rhiza render exit 0. Diff: scratchOps in internal/api/apply.go skips problems wrapping changeset.ErrConcurrent and returns any other fold problem, covering both the start ops and each appended item. New apply-concurrent.txtar builds concurrent entries as check.txtar does, shows the check warn with no fail, runs apply --dry-run and apply (add b, set a), change show lists node.create, render+check prints ok and only the warn; then a hand-written ops entry dropping an unwritten op makes apply --dry-run and apply fail with 'changeset: illegal revision' and the log entry count stays 2. In a scratch worktree with the old apply.go the new script fails at apply --dry-run, so it exercises the fix. No stubs or TODOs; only the leaf's files plus actor records changed.
